overview: Oggy is welcoming a guest for vacation: Piya , a 7 year old elephant, the daughter of his Indian friends. Tender hearted, happy go lucky, and full of energy, the elephant will completely derail Oggy’s daily grind, and the blue cat will learn how to be a surrogate parent. It’s a dream come true for the roaches, who see Piya as a new way to make Oggy’s life miserable.
